Use case: ui-mockup
ONE actual Lighthouse LH15-0016: filmstrip of six files for batch move. No full app/device.
Image1 ORIGINAL primary for thumbnail geometry/crop/proportions, fine spacing/alignment and visible clipping. Use only6files/Rename and filmstrip region at x47 y410 w1132 h335. It shows FIVE full rounded thumbnails and only a NARROW LEFT SLIVER of sixth at RIGHT EDGE, because strip overflows viewport. Preserve that actual visible state. Image2 OUR MOCK secondary for exact Japanese labels; its black padding inside sixth thumbnail is a crop artifact, not actual content. Do NOT reproduce a black rectangle or invent unseen sixth artwork.
Images3 and4 are original-derived crops of the woman portrait and bridge/walker for critical identity/detail fidelity. All six separate crops were inspected; five-input tool limit means kitchen/countryside/mountain crops are not supplied separately. Their actual source thumbnails remain visible in image1. Preserve all first-five artwork/identity/crop observed:1 kitchen window/sunflowers/bread/kettle;2 green countryside/wind turbines;3 person walking away on suspension bridge in mist;4 snowy mountain/pink sky;5 same woman's portrait. Do not invent different photos/faces. Sixth visible sliver is pastries/cups as visible at image1 edge only; keep narrow partial sliver, no fabricated remainder.
Image5 approved bus white-material craft only, no bus content.
Visible copy EXACT: "6件のファイル" upper-left; "名前を変更" far upper-right. Meiryo Bold12/16px count; Regular12/16px action, tracking0, no huge heading.
Compact logical390px-wide group,16px insets. Header row then one horizontal strip of rounded square thumbnails with original proportional spacing; show5complete thumbnails plus a small partial sixth clipped by right viewport edge. Keep count6 even though last image is partially hidden. No arrows/badges/new controls. Retain all actual photos and crops.
Pure#FFFFFF canvas/surface, one restrained rounded group with subtle neutral border/soft shadow. No separate card around each photo. Source Rename blue is real text action, adapt to forest-green#1F6444; original photographic colors stay original. No mint wash, new accent, gradient button, glow or gloss.
Original fine details/visible state override rough mock. Exclude source folder picker/search/destination rows/Upload button/navigation/English/watermark, added file info, IDs or annotations. Static design candidate.
reviewNotes: All original full source, six distinct crops and mock were opened. Original photo/crop/spacing authority; source Rename blue adaptedgreen, original colors retained. Output inspected:6count, rename, five full photos and partial sixth, no black-padding artifact. However original photographic details/portrait are reinterpreted rather than literal preserved media, requiring correction.5-input limit handled by selecting full source/mock/portrait/bridge/style after inspecting all; unseen sixth remainder not invented. No owner/native/runtime acceptance.
